title: Holiday Makers Market | Day 1
seo_title: Holiday Makers Market Day 1 in Joplin, MO
description: The Holiday Makers Market is a festive event at Spiva Center for the Arts where you can find unique gifts and support local makers. It starts Friday, December 4, 2026 at 5:00 PM and runs to Saturday, December 5 at 10:00 AM, at 215 W 7th St in Joplin, MO. Anyone interested in a booth can contact Kearstin Mattox at 417-681-9801.
